descriptions.notStarted: I need to go see Grako!!
descriptions.inProgress: Grako of Showa Town has a stomach ache which seems to have stemmed from indigestion. I wanted to get Grako some medicine, but she said she doesn't think she'll need a medicine; instead, she wants to drink soft cider. I should go get some cider for her..\n\n#t2022002#  #b#c2022002##k/1
descriptions.completed: I gave Grako the cider, but... oh man, he's been FAKING IT! Arrrgh... and anyway, he said he actually wants to ask for another favor, this one being REAL. Should I trust him this time?
